summary: Ben-Gvir published a video from a visit to Damon prison in which he confronted Palestinian female security prisoners about detention conditions and presented the harsh-conditions policy as his responsibility. On Aug. 31 the Public Committee Against Torture in Israel asked Central Elections Committee chair Justice Noam Sohlberg to order removal of the video, alleging unlawful campaign use of public assets and harm to prisoner dignity/privacy.
notes: Exact same-event video is publicly preserved in Ben-Gvir's Aug. 30 X post and contemporaneous reporting. The NGO complaint is an allegation, not a ruling. No Central Elections Committee decision on this Damon video was recovered in the freshness pass, so do not characterize the conduct as a proven election-law violation or canonicalize an adverse event yet. Prior separate CEC findings about other Ben-Gvir videos are background only and are not imported as a finding in this case.
